Débit disque en lecture par pod

queries.query:
SELECT _timestamp, service_name, http_request_method, http_route, url_path,
       http_response_status_code, duration, trace_id
FROM "default"
WHERE span_kind = '2' AND service_k8s_namespace_name IN ($namespace_name) AND service_k8s_workload_name IN ($workload) AND service_k8s_pod_name IN ($instance)
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT _timestamp, service_name, http_request_method, http_route, url_path,
       http_response_status_code, duration, trace_id
FROM "default"
WHERE span_kind = '2' AND http_response_status_code LIKE '5%' AND service_k8s_namespace_name IN ($namespace_name) AND service_k8s_workload_name IN ($workload) AND service_k8s_pod_name IN ($instance)
ORDER BY _timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Top 20 des routes les plus lentes

queries.query:
SELECT service_name || ' ' || http_request_method || ' ' || http_route AS route,
       approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5)  AS p50,
       approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.9)  AS p90,
       approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) AS p95,
       approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.99) AS p99,
       count(*) AS requests
FROM "default"
WHERE span_kind = '2' AND http_route IS NOT NULL AND http_route != '' AND service_k8s_namespace_name IN ($namespace_name) AND service_k8s_workload_name IN ($workload) AND service_k8s_pod_name IN ($instance)
GROUP BY route ORDER BY p99 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT _timestamp, service_name, operation_name, db_query_text, duration, trace_id
FROM "default"
WHERE span_kind = '3' AND db_system_name IS NOT NULL AND db_query_text != ''
  AND service_k8s_namespace_name IN ($namespace_name) AND service_k8s_workload_name IN ($workload) AND service_k8s_pod_name IN ($instance)
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 100
